info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_International Scheduled Payments Details API
info.description: The International Scheduled Payments Details API provides a comprehensive view of payment details for scheduled international transactions. This API allows financial institutions and payment service providers to retrieve specific information regarding payment requests, including status updates and transaction specifics. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service platforms that facilitate cross-border payments. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their user experience and ensure transparency in payment processes.

get.summary: Retrieve payment details for an international scheduled payment.
get.description: This operation allows users to fetch detailed information regarding a specific international scheduled payment using its unique identifier. It provides insights into the payment status, amount, and recipient details, helping users track their transactions effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the payment details for the specified international scheduled payment. Make sure to include all necessary identifiers and parameters to ensure the correct payment information is retrieved.

GetPaymentDetailsForInternationalSchedul.description: This schema represents the request body for international scheduled payments operations, specifically for GET requests. It is expected to contain a string value that conforms to the specified payment details format.

PaymentStatus.description: A list of payment statuses indicating the details of each payment transaction.

Data.description: Contains payment status information and additional details.

GetPaymentDetailsForInternationalSchedul.description: Response schema for the payment details API, detailing the status of payments, links for pagination, metadata, and associated data.
